text:
mohit: Heads-up — nightly eval spiked after pset v43 merged to main. NER F1 dropped 0.92 -> 0.84 on canonical optional-field slice. looks like a systematic entity-span shift.

eval-bot: nightly-evals | run_id=2026-03-20-02 | link: https://internal.eval/reports/2257891234 | regressions: 26 cases, top slice=optional_phone_or_email

katie: ugh. do we have a minimal repro? any changed prompts in v43?

mohit: primary change in v43 was tightening instructions for concision. suspect that made model omit delimiters and merged tokens. sample bad gen below:

```
prompt: "Customer record:
Name: Alice
Phone: (optional)
If none, leave blank."
gold: "Phone: " (no span)
model gen (regressed): "Phone: none — reach at alice@example.com"
```

mohit: you can see model invents contact and attaches an email span where none exists -> label mismatch.

jen: interesting. could be prompt phrasing + tokenizer boundary. we saw similar when we removed trailing punctuation in pset v39.

samir: also worth checking quantization variant used for nightly. which artifact ran?

mohit: rwd-7b-ptq:v2 on nightly. I repro'd locally on that artifact too.

katie: ok. quick mitigation options: 1) revert the concision instruction in pset v43, 2) rebaseline the affected golden examples, 3) add canonicalization to the eval harness to normalize "none/blank/na". Which do we prefer?

derek: +3 for canonicalizer as short-term. Rebaselining hides errors. Revert if urgent. Also I'll run tokenizer-delta across 2k samples to see boundary differences.

jen: agree. canonicalizer reduces flakiness and lets us keep the better prompts. but we need a PR that explicitly documents the normalization.

mohit: I'll open PR: pset/v43 -> pset/v43.1 with eval-canonicalizer + a small unit test that covers optional-field cases. will also add a canary job that runs 100 optional-slice examples against rwd-7b-ptq and rwd-7b-fp16.

katie: can you tag me in the PR? I'll approve the canary and run it overnight.

mohit: yes — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/psets/pull/512 (wip). includes repro snippet and test.

derek: started tokenizer-delta job: job_id=td-2257891300. will post results in this thread.

eval-bot: canary scheduled | job=canary-optional-slice | target_artifacts=[rwd-7b-ptq:v2, rwd-7b-fp16:v5] | eta=6h

samir: small note — if canonicalizer fixes < 80% of cases we should consider a targeted prompt fix instead (e.g., explicitly add "If no phone, write N/A").

mohit: agreed. plan: 1) land canonicalizer PR, 2) run canary overnight, 3) if coverage < 80% then push pset text tweak to v43.2.

katie: sounds good. thanks for the quick triage. :pray:

mohit: thanks team — I'll follow up with PR link and results.

jen: file a short note for release notes/QA so we don't auto-rebaseline without review.

mohit: will do.
